# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m159 and WebAssembly**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.159.0 release brings Skia m159 improvements and requires .NET 9 or later for WebAssembly. The engine update brings WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and image and rendering correctness fixes. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move WebAssembly consumers to .NET 9 or later** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp no longer provide .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets; unsupported WASM frameworks are rejected before building. Retarget WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later and use runtime-matched native archives: .NET 9/10 use Emscripten 3.1.56, while .NET 11+ use 6.0.2. Newer archives are not interchangeable with older .NET toolchains. Non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged. ([#5700](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5700))

## Engine

- **Skia m159** — Updates the native engine with WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and image and rendering correctness fixes. C API exports and public managed signatures remain unchanged. ([#5685](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5685))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Hash-code seed uses OS randomness** — The shared HashCode polyfill in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now seeds from RandomNumberGenerator rather than System.Random. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now loads the cryptography library. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
